card.title: THALA
card.text: The town of Thala guards the route to northern Tunisia.

Text.SourceString: The town of Thala guards the route to northern Tunisia.
Text.LocalizedString: The town of Thala guards the route to northern Tunisia.

value.value: Reinforcements are arriving from the north.

SourceString.value: Reinforcements are arriving from the north.

value.value: We are successfully targeting enemy supply convoys sailing from Sicily to Tunisia.

SourceString.value: We are successfully targeting enemy supply convoys sailing from Sicily to Tunisia.

value.value: A French artillery unit is close to Thala, ready to enter the fray.

SourceString.value: A French artillery unit is close to Thala, ready to enter the fray.

value.value: US forces are in position to strike at the Axis from Tebessa.

SourceString.value: US forces are in position to strike at the Axis from Tebessa.

value.value: Rommel has conquered the town of Kasserine and is now ready to enter the pass itself. We have American and French troops defending, let’s hope they can hold.

SourceString.value: Rommel has conquered the town of Kasserine and is now ready to enter the pass itself. We have American and French troops defending, let’s hope they can hold.

value.value: We have finally driven the Axis back from Kasserine Pass. Now let’s strike towards their HQ to seal victory.

SourceString.value: We have finally driven the Axis back from Kasserine Pass. Now let’s strike towards their HQ to seal victory.

value.value: The pass has fallen and Rommel is driving on towards Thala. An American unit has arrived to reinforce our defense of the town.
